tips: Prioritize Reels format over standard images and text breaking posts, as Reels generate 30x more reach and are driving virtually all actual views and monetization potential.
Focus on high-impact tech disruptions, corporate business crises, and historic US political shifts, using objective, factual impact hooks (e.g., service outages, historic elections).
Cut down heavily on US domestic scandal stories (like House impeachment drama) and low-stakes regional cultural/holiday reporting, which consistently score 0 engagement.
Schedule high-value posts strictly between 12:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC, which accounts for the highest engagement multiplier (peaking at 2.01x at 14:00 and 19:00 UTC).
Use English for global tech, US politics, and business reels to maximize broad algorithmic distribution, while keeping Urdu for regional sports and high-interest Pakistan/Middle East breaking news.

news.summary: Page par Reels sab se zyada reach aur views de rahi hain, jabke photos aur text posts bilkul perform nahi kar rahay. Americas aur general Asia ki khabron par engagement zero rahi hai, is liye hum ne USA, Business aur Tech ko barha diya hai aur kamzor topics ko kam kar diya hai. Posting ke liye sab se behtareen waqt 12:00 se 20:00 UTC hai jahan response double mil raha hai. Ab zyada tawajjo viral Reels formats par hogi taake views aur monetization tezi se barhein.

tips: Prioritize Urdu language posts over English, as Urdu content significantly outperforms English (x0.49 vs x0.26 avg score).
Focus on high-performing video formats (Reels, Match highlights, Long videos) featuring action-heavy content like Wrestling, Boxing, MMA, Esports, and Snooker.
Avoid posting static pics and generic breaking news posts on niche sports like Golf, Rugby, Cycling, and Basketball which have very low engagement (x0.05 to x0.17).
Post exclusively during peak UTC hours (12:00 - 20:00 UTC, especially 14:00, 18:00, and 19:00 UTC) and avoid early morning dead zones (04:00 - 09:00 UTC).
Craft Urdu hooks around iconic player moments (e.g., Manchester United historic clips) or big fights/heavyweight clashes instead of generic team-of-the-week lists.
